title: WRRA M separate channel response audit v0.1
carrier_status: supplied one-generation 15-chiral-channel representation content; antiparticle channels are conjugate representations, not extra entries in this basis
hypercharge_convention: Q = T3 + Y, with this Y equal to one half of the Y used in the PDG convention Q = T3 + Y_PDG/2

state_record_schema.address: candidate arithmetic residue label; may be shared by several internal states
state_record_schema.sector: baryon, lepton or other selected physical readout sector
state_record_schema.valence: net valence flavor counts; not the entire QCD constituent content
state_record_schema.internal_state: color, chirality, spin-flavor-spatial state, orbital excitation and density matrix
state_record_schema.additional_QCD_content: sea quark-antiquark pairs and gluons enter the effective state and response, not fixed prime multiplicities here
state_record_schema.environment: free particle or bound system, external fields, scale and renormalization scheme
state_record_schema.response_parameters: constrained energy, current and transition kernels; parameters must have independent input or a recorded calibration

separate_responses.constituents: valence flavor and channel counts; address prime factors are candidate labels
separate_responses.strong: eight color generators on each quark color triplet; three-quark color-singlet invariance checked. Binding energy and alpha_s running are separate constitutive inputs.
separate_responses.residual_nuclear: inter-nucleon binding and effective nuclear interactions require a bound-system environment; not computed by the free-nucleon color audit
separate_responses.weak: four left doublets (three colored quark and one lepton); right channels weak singlets. Raising dL->uL and eL->nuL computed. Transition strengths, mixing and gA are further inputs.
separate_responses.electromagnetic: Q=T3+Y; electric charges and signed magnetic-current readout are distinct
separate_responses.spin: three spin halves yield two spin-half multiplets and one spin-three-half multiplet; a full spin-flavor-spatial state must choose the branch
separate_responses.mass: shared nucleon energy response in the companion trial; not integer product or Omega alone
separate_responses.decay: allowed flavor-channel transition, energy condition and rate; Actual energy retention is distinct from phenotype lifetime

coupling_inputs_recorded.strong_coupling: must specify scale and renormalization scheme; no numerical alpha_s fit in this audit
